spectral_openings.location: WAO KELE O PUNA : ISLAND OF HAWAII : AIRBORNE IMAGING SPECTROSCOPY

sentences.text: Hyperspectral imaging separates vegetation into many spectral signatures
Canopy openings can add lower leaves to this mixed signal
At one field site a classifier finds the same signature repeating
Field plots identify this signature as invasive strawberry guava
Spectral identity is evidence of species not fuel
